protocol_amendments.prior_rule: stop when any fixed-cohort slide lacks a stable native scanner device ID
protocol_amendments.amended_rule: retain every slide in the primary evaluation and exclude only missing-device-ID slides from scanner-held-out slices
protocol_amendments.reason: Missing scanner metadata limits scanner-stratified analysis but does not invalidate source integrity, slide labels, or deterministic feature extraction.

protocol_amendments.prior_rule: name any annotated artifact presence truth_reject and any detected signal prediction_reject
protocol_amendments.amended_rule: name the same values truth_artifact_present and predicted_artifact_present; emit spatial signals; do not assess slide or region usability
protocol_amendments.reason: AIRAQc labels artifact pixels, not fitness for an unspecified downstream use. The prior names conflated artifact detection with a product rejection policy. Thresholds, labels, cohort membership, and performance calculations are unchanged.
